description: Manual transcription of successful remote Import and lexical-scan responses. Whole articles were not all semantically reread.
discovery: Pinned recursive GitHub tree: 72 TeX files under external-reports/code-review, including article components and reference files.
wave1_extra_patterns: The initial wave-1 scan also used 50-character predicate windows and cancellation/parameter-singularity terms. Its one extra match, report 8 line 162, concerned held arithmetic cancelling denominators, not N01 or H01.
limits: Patterns are line-local; alternative wording or line breaks can evade them.
No claim is made that all scripts, JSON findings and binary artifacts were exhaustively searched.
All six review indexes and substantial portions of the maintained status register were read; selected nearest original discussions were read separately.
Failed remote scan calls were retried in smaller batches; failed calls contributed no results.

nearest_semantic_comparisons.distinction: Concerns real finite trigonometric arguments versus unknown errors. N01 instead uses an exact real input x and falsely accepts a conditional Element predicate.
One-sided observable Taylor constants and returned oracle precision. N01 here is a Boolean admission rule for the condition, before constructing the constant body.
The new witness uses constant body 1 and follows the condition-checking route, rather than the Log/Exp/Power early return described by the existing review.
These broad workstreams preexist. The report does not re-list them as new findings. H01 supplies a specific conjugacy-preserving coefficient representation and exact operation-count model.
